source:
The protagonist named "Emma", ​​is a detective assigned a mission to gather information. A mafia recently emerged out of nowhere, led by a woman known as "Madame red," and quickly became the most dangerous of them all. It is "Emma's" job to uncover the identity of this mysterious woman while battling her own sleep issues, every day, the investigation continues in search of the truth.

translation:
名叫“艾玛”的女主角是一名奉命搜集情报的侦探。近期，一个由外号“红夫人”的神秘女子统领的黑手党凭空崛起，迅速成了所有帮派中最危险的存在。“艾玛”的任务便是在与自身睡眠障碍抗争的同时查明这位神秘女子的真实身份；日复一日，追寻真相的调查仍在继续。
